last_verified.normal_state: On codex/ws-diagnostics, host-side diagnostics now redact quoted JSON and colon/equal credential forms, compile the report schema as Draft 2020-12, and validate a generated diagnostics bundle. The standalone bootstrap declares its shared CLI dependencies. The CLI package has 83 unit and 22 integration tests passing; focused formatting, CLI/bootstrap Clippy, bootstrap checks, fetch, diagnostics, scoped verify, and host-only smoke pass. The M1/M7 QEMU smoke timed out at 30 seconds. The full workspace test command cannot assemble x86-64 libnagi syscall registers on this aarch64 host, and repository-wide fmt reports differences in fetched upstream Servo files. Those results do not change M17 status. DF-01 is absent from this source branch, so the workstream-state health check is SKIPPED; its existing validator remains an integration dependency. Branch CI run 36249804255 completed both Ubuntu and Windows host jobs successfully; its target job remains in the independent M17 acceptance; prior source CI 36215571919 failed only at the standalone bootstrap dependency check, which the local build now passes. The integration-branch run 36240025711 passed host jobs and failed in the separate M17 QEMU path. The persisted diagnostics state was also validated against the registered workstream-state Draft 2020-12 schema.

release_line_gate.activation_requirement: This checkpoint provides host-side diagnostics contracts only. Guest crash persistence, target event collection, or production diagnostics service integration require Nagi 0.1 M30 PASS and an explicit release boundary.

do_not_try: Do not treat --vm smoke as evidence for the strict M17 first-web-pixel gate.
Do not add target crash persistence or guest event collection before the M30 plus explicit integration release gate.
Do not edit x86-64 libnagi assembly from the Diagnostics workstream or alter the existing M1/M7/M17 acceptance criteria.
Do not modify fetched third_party/servo files to silence repository-wide rustfmt output.
Do not upload local diagnostics reports unless the user explicitly selects an output path.

After the DF-01 registry is integrated into this source line, register its owner-provided validator through the HealthCheck seam. acceptance_criteria: Versioned structured events and reports enforce bounds, safe redaction, unique check IDs, and outcome derivation.
Registered health checks are scoped, continue after individual failures, and classify host versus VM evidence.
Diagnostics, verify, and host smoke commands pass with reports written only to an explicit output path.
When DF-01 is present, the workstreams health check reuses the authoritative nagi dev verify validator; when absent, it reports SKIPPED.
Crash capture remains a bounded portable contract and does not claim target persistence.
No diagnostics result changes M17 or any later milestone status without that milestone's acceptance evidence.
deferred: Target crash persistence and guest event collection until the relevant runtime boundary and release gate are available.
M1/M7 QEMU smoke remains an independent acceptance boundary; its current 30-second timeout does not imply any M17 first-web-pixel result.
Register the DF-01 state validator after its authoritative registry and validator are integrated into this workstream source line.

cross_workstream_dependencies.contract: Reuse the DF-01 registry and state validator through nagi dev verify, and align failure classes to the accepted durable-state vocabulary.
